en: An ornate, vintage postcard bordered with decorative floral designs and crests/emblems of various cities or regions (such as Trento, Borgo, Merano, Ala, Riva, Arco, Bressanone, Rovereto, Bolzano, and Brunico). The text 'LEGIONE CARABINIERI REALI TRENTO' is prominently displayed in the center. Below this, there is an illustration of a castle-like building with an Italian flag flying atop, set against a mountainous backdrop.
